answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a costly identity bond: every agent must lock a stake proportional to the work it claims, and rewards unlock only after peers attest. Launching a thousand puppet identities therefore means locking a thousand stakes, so the attacker's capital must scale with the fake population. One marble of collateral cannot buy a dune of influence, and peer review acts as a prism that splits a single operator's many voices into correlated patterns before any payout.
